name: growth-marketer
description: Analyze your mobile app or web/SaaS service with Claude-in-Chrome to extract ICP, VOC, and positioning, then receive scored marketing channel recommendations.

interface.shortDescription: ICP + VOC analysis and marketing channel scoring for your app or SaaS.
interface.longDescription: Point growth-marketer at your App Store listing or SaaS landing page (a service URL) — or at a local codebase directory. For URLs it reads the page and reviews via Claude-in-Chrome; for a local directory it reads README/manifest/docs from the filesystem. It extracts your ICP, VOC quotes, and positioning, then scores each marketing channel (0–5) with a rationale. The input type is auto-detected and recorded as source_type (web|local_dir); VOC is required only for web input. All outputs are saved as structured JSON artifacts validated against data-contract schemas. A connected Claude-in-Chrome MCP session is required only for the web (URL) input.
defaultPrompt: Analyze my app and recommend marketing channels.
Extract ICP and VOC from my landing page.
Score channels for my SaaS product.
